```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
#| cache: false

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(bayesma)
library(posterior)
library(loo)
library(scoringRules)

source("Functions.R")

# Reproducibility
set.seed(1404)
options(
  mc.cores = parallel::detectCores(),
  digits = 3
)

# Analysis constants (protocol Section 2.7, Table 1; Section 2.8.10)
MCID_LOS_DAYS   <- 0.5    # hospital length of stay
MCID_RES_HOURS  <- 6      # time to DKA resolution / insulin infusion duration
MCID_RES24_PROP <- 0.10   # proportion resolved at 24 h
ROPE_LOS        <- c(-0.5, 0.5)
ROPE_LOS_ALT    <- list(narrow = c(-0.25, 0.25), wide = c(-1, 1))
ROPE_ROM        <- c(0.93, 1.07)
BASELINE_RES24 <- 0.53

# Priors
# Primary outcome: prespecified (protocol)
# Secondary continuous outcomes: weakly regularising, mu ~ N(0, 1 SD), tau ~ HN(0, 0.5 SD),
# with SD = IQR / 1.35 from external data (not the trials in this review)
iqr_sd <- function(q1, q3) (q3 - q1) / 1.35

ext_sd <- c(
  hosp_los = round(iqr_sd(2.39, 6.74),1),   # days; external DKA cohort (n = 6000)
  icu_los = round(iqr_sd(24, 64.2),1),      # hours; external DKA cohort (n = 6000)
  insulin_dur = round(iqr_sd(27, 67),1),    # hours; Chua et al., saline arm
  time_res = round(iqr_sd(27, 67),1))       # hours; insulin duration used as proxy

priors <- list(
  hosp_los = list(mu = normal(0, 1), tau = half_normal(0, 0.75)),
  hosp_los_wr = list(mu = normal(0, ext_sd[["hosp_los"]]), tau = half_normal(0, 0.5 * ext_sd[["hosp_los"]])),
  icu_los = list(mu = normal(0, ext_sd[["icu_los"]]), tau = half_normal(0, 0.5 * ext_sd[["icu_los"]])),
  insulin_dur = list(mu = normal(0, ext_sd[["insulin_dur"]]), tau = half_normal(0, 0.5 * ext_sd[["insulin_dur"]])),
  time_res = list(mu = normal(0, ext_sd[["time_res"]]), tau = half_normal(0, 0.5 * ext_sd[["time_res"]])),
  binary = list(mu = normal(0, 1), tau = half_normal(0, 0.5)))

# Load data
d_dir <- here::here("Data", "Clean")
m_dir <- here::here("Data", "Models")

read_d <- function(name) readRDS(file.path(d_dir, paste0(name, ".rds")))
read_m <- function(name) readRDS(file.path(m_dir, paste0(name, ".rds")))

# --- datasets ---
dat <- read_d("dat")
dat_hosp_los <- read_d("dat_hosp_los")         
dat_icu_los <- read_d("dat_icu_los")    
dat_time_res <- read_d("dat_time_res") 
dat_res24 <- read_d("dat_res24")
dat_res48 <- read_d("dat_res48")
dat_insulin_dur <- read_d("dat_insulin_dur") 
dat_mortality <- read_d("dat_mortality")  
dat_hosp_los_dom <- read_d("dat_hosp_los_dom") 
dat_rom <- read_d("dat_rom")  
counts <- read_d("counts")
dat_ae <- read_d("dat_ae")

method_labels <- c(
  wan = "Wan",
  luo = "Luo",
  qe = "Quantile Estimation",
  bc = "Box-Cox",
  shi = "Shi",
  yang = "Yang")

```

# Results

## Trials

```{r}
#| label: trial-counts

n_trials       <- counts$n_trials
n_participants <- counts$n_participants
n_primary      <- counts$n_primary
n_primary_pts  <- counts$n_primary_pts
```

The search identified `r n_trials` eligible trials with
`r n_participants` participants. Of these, `r n_primary` trials
(`r n_primary_pts` participants) reported hospital length of stay in a
form that could be pooled and contributed to the primary analysis.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-incl-trials

tbl1data <- dat |> 
  dplyr::select(Author, year, country, trial_design, setting, age_group, n_centres, bss_type, ctrl_type, n_analysed_int, n_analysed_ctrl, fluid_vol_mean_int, fluid_vol_sd_int, fluid_vol_median_int, fluid_vol_iqr_int, fluid_vol_mean_ctrl, fluid_vol_sd_ctrl, fluid_vol_median_ctrl, fluid_vol_iqr_ctrl, age_mean_int, age_sd_int, age_median_int, age_iqr_int, age_mean_ctrl, age_sd_ctrl, age_median_ctrl, age_iqr_ctrl, n_male_int, n_male_ctrl, type1_int, type2_int, type_other_int, type1_ctrl, type2_ctrl, type_other_ctrl, primary, secondary) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    trial_design = dplyr::recode_values(
      trial_design,
      "rct" ~ "Individual-patient RCT",
      "XRCT" ~ "Crossover RCT",
      "cRCT" ~ "Cluster RCT",
      "CXRCT" ~ "Cluster-crossover RCT"),
    bss_type = case_when(
      bss_type == "plasmalyte_a" ~ "Plasmalyte A",
      bss_type == "ringers" ~ "Ringer's Solution",
      bss_type == "ringerfundin" ~ "Ringerfundin",
      bss_type == "sterofundin" ~ "Sterofundin",
      bss_type == "plasmalyte_ringers" ~ "Plasmalyte or Ringer's",
      bss_type == "hartmanns" ~ "Hartmann's Solution"), 
    ctrl_type = "0.9% NaCl",
    study = str_glue("{Author} ({year})"),
    int_type_number = str_glue("{bss_type} ({n_analysed_int})"),
    ctrl__type_number = str_glue("{ctrl_type} ({n_analysed_ctrl})"),
    fluid_vol_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(fluid_vol_mean_int) & !is.na(fluid_vol_sd_int) ~
        paste0(round(fluid_vol_mean_int), " (", round(fluid_vol_sd_int), ")"),
      !is.na(fluid_vol_mean_int) ~ as.character(round(fluid_vol_mean_int)),
      !is.na(fluid_vol_median_int) & !is.na(fluid_vol_iqr_int) ~
        paste0(round(fluid_vol_median_int), " (", fluid_vol_iqr_int, ")"),
      !is.na(fluid_vol_median_int) ~ as.character(round(fluid_vol_median_int)),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    fluid_vol_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(fluid_vol_mean_ctrl) & !is.na(fluid_vol_sd_ctrl) ~
        paste0(round(fluid_vol_mean_ctrl), " (", round(fluid_vol_sd_ctrl), ")"),
      !is.na(fluid_vol_mean_ctrl) ~ as.character(round(fluid_vol_mean_ctrl)),
      !is.na(fluid_vol_median_ctrl) & !is.na(fluid_vol_iqr_ctrl) ~
        paste0(round(fluid_vol_median_ctrl), " (", fluid_vol_iqr_ctrl, ")"),
      !is.na(fluid_vol_median_ctrl) ~ as.character(round(fluid_vol_median_ctrl)),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    # Age: mean (SD) or median (IQR)
    age_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(age_mean_int) & !is.na(age_sd_int) ~
        paste0(round(age_mean_int, 1), " (", round(age_sd_int, 1), ")"),
      !is.na(age_mean_int) ~ as.character(round(age_mean_int, 1)),
      !is.na(age_median_int) & !is.na(age_iqr_int) ~
        paste0(round(age_median_int, 1), " (", age_iqr_int, ")"),
      !is.na(age_median_int) ~ as.character(round(age_median_int, 1)),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    age_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(age_mean_ctrl) & !is.na(age_sd_ctrl) ~
        paste0(round(age_mean_ctrl, 1), " (", round(age_sd_ctrl, 1), ")"),
      !is.na(age_mean_ctrl) ~ as.character(round(age_mean_ctrl, 1)),
      !is.na(age_median_ctrl) & !is.na(age_iqr_ctrl) ~
        paste0(round(age_median_ctrl, 1), " (", age_iqr_ctrl, ")"),
      !is.na(age_median_ctrl) ~ as.character(round(age_median_ctrl, 1)),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    # Sex: N (%)
    male_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(n_male_int) ~
        paste0(n_male_int, " (", round(100 * n_male_int / n_analysed_int, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    female_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(n_male_int) ~
        paste0(n_analysed_int - n_male_int, " (",
               round(100 * (n_analysed_int - n_male_int) / n_analysed_int, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    male_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(n_male_ctrl) ~
        paste0(n_male_ctrl, " (", round(100 * n_male_ctrl / n_analysed_ctrl, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    female_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(n_male_ctrl) ~
        paste0(n_analysed_ctrl - n_male_ctrl, " (",
               round(100 * (n_analysed_ctrl - n_male_ctrl) / n_analysed_ctrl, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    # Diabetes type: N (%)
    t1_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(type1_int) ~
        paste0(type1_int, " (", round(100 * type1_int / n_analysed_int, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    t1_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(type1_ctrl) ~
        paste0(type1_ctrl, " (", round(100 * type1_ctrl / n_analysed_ctrl, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    t2_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(type2_int) ~
        paste0(type2_int, " (", round(100 * type2_int / n_analysed_int, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    t2_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(type2_ctrl) ~
        paste0(type2_ctrl, " (", round(100 * type2_ctrl / n_analysed_ctrl, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    type_other_int = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(type_other_int) ~
        paste0(type_other_int, " (", round(100 * type_other_int / n_analysed_int, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    type_other_ctrl = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(type_other_ctrl) ~
        paste0(type_other_ctrl, " (", round(100 * type_other_ctrl / n_analysed_ctrl, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)
  )

# Convert to long format for grouping
tbl1_long <- bind_rows(
   tbl1data |>
     transmute(study, age_group, setting, trial_design,
               arm = int_type_number,
               age = age_int, male = male_int, female = female_int,
               fluid_vol = fluid_vol_int,
               t1dm = t1_int, t2dm = t2_int, other_dm = type_other_int,
               primary, secondary),
   tbl1data |>
     transmute(study, age_group, setting, trial_design,
               arm = ctrl__type_number,
               age = age_ctrl, male = male_ctrl, female = female_ctrl,
               fluid_vol = fluid_vol_ctrl,
               t1dm = t1_ctrl, t2dm = t2_ctrl, other_dm = type_other_ctrl,
               primary, secondary)) |>
   arrange(study) |>
   # Blank out study-level columns on the second (ctrl) row
   group_by(study) |>
   mutate(across(c(trial_design, setting, age_group, primary, secondary),
                 ~ if_else(row_number() > 1, NA_character_, as.character(.)))) |>
   ungroup() |>
   # Collapse sex and diabetes type into single columns
   mutate(
     sex = pmap_chr(list(male, female), \(m, f) {
       parts <- c(
         if (!is.na(m)) paste0("Male: ", m),
         if (!is.na(f)) paste0("Female: ", f))
       if (length(parts) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(parts, collapse = "<br>")
     }),
     dm_type = pmap_chr(list(t1dm, t2dm, other_dm), \(t1, t2, ot) {
       parts <- c(
         if (!is.na(t1)) paste0("Type-1: ", t1),
         if (!is.na(t2)) paste0("Type-2: ", t2),
         if (!is.na(ot)) paste0("Other: ", ot))
       if (length(parts) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(parts, collapse = "<br>")
     })) |>
   select(-male, -female, -t1dm, -t2dm, -other_dm)

# Create table
tbl1 <- tbl1_long |>
   gt(groupname_col = "study") |>
   tab_stubhead(label = "Study") |>
   tab_header(title = "Table 1: Characteristics of Included Trials") |>
   opt_align_table_header(align = "left") |>
   cols_label(
     age_group = "Population",
     setting = "Setting",
     trial_design = "Trial Design",
     arm = "Intervention (n)",
     age = "Age",
     sex = "Sex, n (%)",
     dm_type = "Diabetes Type, n (%)",
     fluid_vol = "IV Fluid (mL)",
     primary = "Primary Outcome",
     secondary = "Secondary Outcome") |>
   cols_move(columns = fluid_vol, after = dm_type) |>
   cols_move(columns = c(primary, secondary), after = fluid_vol) |>
   sub_missing(missing_text = "") |>
   fmt_markdown(columns = c(sex, dm_type)) |>
   tab_options(
     row_group.as_column = TRUE,
     row_group.border.top.width = px(3),
     row_group.font.weight = "bold",
     table.border.bottom.width = px(3),
     table.border.bottom.color = "black",
     table.border.top.color = "white",
     heading.border.bottom.color = "black",
     heading.border.bottom.width = px(3),
     heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
     table.font.size = px(12)) |>
   tab_style(
     locations = cells_body(columns = everything(), rows = everything()),
     style = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = "white")) |>
   tab_style(
     locations = cells_column_labels(columns = everything()),
     style = list(
       cell_text(weight = "bold"),
       cell_borders(sides = "bottom", weight = px(3)))) |>
   tab_style(
     locations = cells_row_groups(groups = everything()),
     style = cell_text(weight = "bold")) |>
   tab_style(
     locations = cells_stubhead(),

       cell_text(weight = "bold"),
       cell_borders(sides = "bottom", weight = px(3)))) |>
   tab_style(
     locations = cells_body(columns = everything()),
     style = cell_borders(sides = "left", weight = px(1), color = "lightgrey")) |>
   cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) |>
   tab_footnote(
     footnote = "Age reported as mean (SD) or median (Q1, Q3). IV Fluid reported as mean (SD) or median (Q1, Q3).",
     locations = cells_column_labels(columns = age)) |>
   tab_footnote(
     footnote = "AG, anion gap; AKI, acute kidney injury; BE, base excess; Cl, chloride; DAO, days alive and out of; DAOH-28, days alive and out of hospital to day 28; HCO3, bicarbonate; K, potassium; LOS, length of stay; MAKE30, major adverse kidney events at 30 days; MV, mechanical ventilation; Na, sodium; res, resolution; resus, resuscitation; RRT, renal replacement therapy; SBE, standard base excess; SC, subcutaneous; SID, strong ion difference.",
     locations = cells_column_labels(columns = c(primary, secondary)))
```

## Primary Outcome

```{r}
#| label: primary-outcome-fit
#| include: false

fit_hosp_los_re <- bayesma(
  data       = dat_hosp_los,
  studyvar   = "Author",
  mean_ctrl = "mean_ctrl",
  mean_int  = "mean_int",
  sd_ctrl = "sd_ctrl",
  sd_int = "sd_int",
  n_ctrl     = "n_ctrl",
  n_int      = "n_int",
  likelihood = "gaussian",
  estimand   = "MD",
  model_type = "random_effect",
  stage      = "two_stage",
  mu_prior   = priors$hosp_los$mu,
  tau_prior  = priors$hosp_los$tau)

```

The pooled mean difference in hospital length of stay was
`r round(fit_hosp_los_re$summary$median[1], 2)` days (95% CrI
`r round(fit_hosp_los_re$summary$q2.5[1], 2)` to
`r round(fit_hosp_los_re$summary$q97.5[1], 2)`), with a posterior
probability of benefit (shorter stay with BMES) of
`r scales::percent(mean(fit_hosp_los_re$draws$mu < 0), accuracy = 0.1)`
and a posterior probability of a clinically meaningful reduction (\>
`r MCID_LOS_DAYS` days) of
`r scales::percent(mean(fit_hosp_los_re$draws$mu < -MCID_LOS_DAYS), accuracy = 0.1)`.

## Subgroup Analysis

Subgroup analyses were pre-specified for the primary outcome only
(protocol Table 2): age group (adults \$\geq\$18 years versus children
\<18 years) and BMES type. Subgroup-specific pooled estimates and the
posterior difference between subgroups are reported.

::: panel-tabset

## Age Group: Meta-Regression

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10
#| out-width: "100%"

metareg_age <- meta_reg(data = dat_hosp_los,
         studyvar = "Author",
         mods = ~ age_group,
         mean_ctrl = "mean_ctrl",
         mean_int  = "mean_int",
         sd_ctrl = "sd_ctrl",
         sd_int = "sd_int",
         n_ctrl     = "n_ctrl",
         n_int      = "n_int",
         likelihood = "gaussian",
         model_type = "random_effect",
         stage      = "two_stage",
         mu_prior   = normal(0, 1),
         tau_prior  = half_normal(0, 0.75))

subgroup_rows <- function(fit, coef, labels, units = "days", ratio = FALSE) {
  mu <- fit$draws$mu
  beta <- fit$draws[[paste0("beta_", coef)]]

  draws <- list(mu, mu + beta, beta) |>
    rlang::set_names(c(labels, paste0("Difference (", labels[2], " \u2212 ", labels[1], ")")))

  draws |>
    purrr::imap(\(x, nm) {
      q <- stats::quantile(x, c(0.5, 0.025, 0.975), names = FALSE)
      if (ratio) q <- exp(q)
      tibble::tibble(
        Subgroup = nm,
        `Estimate [95% CrI]` = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", q[1], q[2], q[3]),
        `Pr(< 0)` = mean(x < 0))
    }) |>
    purrr::list_rbind()
}

subgroup_rows(metareg_age, coef = "age_groupPaediatric", labels = c("Adult", "Paediatric")) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(`Estimate [95% CrI]` = "MD, days [95% CrI]", `Pr(< 0)` = "Pr(Benefit)") |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `Pr(< 0)`, decimals = 2) |>
  gt::cols_align("center", columns = -Subgroup) |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::md("**Hospital length of stay by age group**")) |>
  style_gt() |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(style = "italic"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(rows = grepl("^Difference", Subgroup))) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Bayesian random-effects meta-regression with age group as a moderator; between-study heterogeneity (\u03c4) shared across subgroups.",
    locations = gt::cells_title("title")) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "For the difference row: posterior probability of a greater reduction in children than adults.",
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(`Pr(< 0)`))
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
       i_mean  = "mean_int",
       c_sd = "sd_ctrl",
       i_sd = "sd_int",
       c_n     = "n_ctrl",
       i_n      = "n_int",
       subgroup = TRUE,
       subgroup_var = "bmes_type",
       label_intervention = "BMES",
       label_control = "0.9% NaCl")
```

## BMES Fluid: Meta-regression
```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10
#| out-width: "100%"

metareg_bmes <- meta_reg(data = dat_hosp_los,
         studyvar = "Author",
         mods = ~ bmes_type,
         mean_ctrl = "mean_ctrl",
         mean_int  = "mean_int",
         sd_ctrl = "sd_ctrl",
         sd_int = "sd_int",
         n_ctrl     = "n_ctrl",
         n_int      = "n_int",
         likelihood = "gaussian",
         model_type = "random_effect",
         stage      = "two_stage",
         mu_prior   = normal(0, 1),
         tau_prior  = half_normal(0, 0.75))

subgroup_rows(metareg_bmes, coef = "bmes_typeRinger's Solution", labels = c("Ringer's Solution", "Plasma-Lyte")) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(`Estimate [95% CrI]` = "MD, days [95% CrI]", `Pr(< 0)` = "Pr(Benefit)") |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `Pr(< 0)`, decimals = 2) |>
  gt::cols_align("center", columns = -Subgroup) |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::md("**Hospital length of stay by BMES type**")) |>
  style_gt() |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(style = "italic"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(rows = grepl("^Difference", Subgroup))) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Bayesian random-effects meta-regression with BMES group as a moderator; between-study heterogeneity (\u03c4) shared across subgroups.",
    locations = gt::cells_title("title")) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "For the difference row: posterior probability of a greater reduction in Plasma-Lyte than Ringer's solution",
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(`Pr(< 0)`))
```
:::

## Secondary Outcomes

Secondary outcomes were ICU length of stay, time to DKA resolution,
duration of intravenous insulin infusion, and mortality.

Secondary continuous outcomes used weakly regularising priors
($\mu \sim N(0, 1\ \text{SD})$, $\tau \sim \text{HN}(0, 0.5\ \text{SD})$),
with the outcome SD estimated as IQR/1.35 from external data rather than
from the included trials: ICU length of stay from ANZICS APD with
patients with DKA (SD ≈ `r round(ext_sd[["icu_los"]])` hours), and
duration of insulin infusion from the saline arm of Chua et al. (SD ≈
`r round(ext_sd[["insulin_dur"]])` hours).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-priors

tibble::tribble(
  ~Outcome, ~Units, ~`External SD`, ~Source, ~`μ prior`, ~`τ prior`,
  "Hospital LOS (primary, prespecified)", "days", NA, "Protocol", "N(0, 1)", "HN(0, 0.75)",
  "Hospital LOS (weakly regularising, sensitivity)", "days", ext_sd[["hosp_los"]], "Venkatesh (2015)",
    sprintf("N(0, %.1f)", ext_sd[["hosp_los"]]), sprintf("HN(0, %.1f)", 0.5 * ext_sd[["hosp_los"]]),
  "ICU LOS", "hours", ext_sd[["icu_los"]], "Venkatesh (2015)",
    sprintf("N(0, %.0f)", ext_sd[["icu_los"]]), sprintf("HN(0, %.0f)", 0.5 * ext_sd[["icu_los"]]),
  "Time to DKA resolution", "hours", ext_sd[["time_res"]], "Chua (2012) (insulin duration)",
    sprintf("N(0, %.0f)", ext_sd[["time_res"]]), sprintf("HN(0, %.0f)", 0.5 * ext_sd[["time_res"]]),
  "DKA resolution at 24 hours", "RD", NA, "\u2014", "N(0, 1)", NA,
  "Duration of insulin infusion", "hours", ext_sd[["insulin_dur"]], "Chua (2012) (saline arm)",
    sprintf("N(0, %.0f)", ext_sd[["insulin_dur"]]), sprintf("HN(0, %.0f)", 0.5 * ext_sd[["insulin_dur"]]),
  "Mortality and adverse events", "log RR", NA, "\u2014", "N(0, 1)", "HN(0, 0.5)") |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `External SD`, decimals = 1) |>
  gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "\u2014") |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::md("**Prior distributions**")) |>
  style_gt() |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "SD estimated as IQR/1.35 from external data, not from trials included in this review.",
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(`External SD`)) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Common-effect model (four trials), so no \u03c4 prior; reported as the marginal risk difference.",
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = Outcome, rows = Outcome == "DKA resolution at 24 hours"))
```

### Primary and Secondary Outcome Summary Table

```{r,warning=FALSE}

tbl_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summary_row(fit_hosp_los_re, "Hospital LOS", "MD", "days") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Group = "Primary"),
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    summary_row(fit_icu_los_re, "ICU LOS", "MD", "hours"),
    summary_row(fit_dka_res_re, "Time to DKA resolution", "MD", "hours"),
    res_row(fit_res24_ce, "DKA resolution at 24 hours"),
    summary_row(fit_insulin_dur_re, "Duration of insulin infusion", "MD", "hours"),
    summary_row(fits_ae$Mortality, "Mortality", "RR", "", ratio = TRUE) |>
      dplyr::mutate(ess = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Group = "Secondary")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ess = dplyr::coalesce(ess, FALSE),
    ce = dplyr::coalesce(ce, FALSE)) |>
  dplyr::relocate(Group)

outcome_col <- names(tbl_summary)[2]

tbl_summary |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Group") |>
  gt::cols_hide(c(ess, ce)) |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("**BMES vs 0.9% NaCl: pooled effects**"),
    subtitle = "Bayesian meta-analysis") |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = dplyr::starts_with("Pr("), decimals = 2) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Posterior probability the effect favours BMES (shorter stay/duration, more patients resolved, lower mortality).",
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(`Pr(Benefit)`)) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Cluster crossover trials adjusted using effective sample size.",
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = dplyr::all_of(outcome_col), rows = ess)) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Common-effect model (four trials); all other outcomes random-effects.",
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = dplyr::all_of(outcome_col), rows = ce)) |>
  gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "\u2014")
```

## Adverse Events

Pooled counts of trial-reported adverse events, with a two-stage Bayesian
random-effects risk ratio (binomial likelihood; $\mu \sim N(0, 1)$,
$\tau \sim \text{HN}(0, 0.5)$ on the log-RR scale) fitted to each event.
Cluster crossover trials were adjusted using effective sample size. RR < 1
favours BMES. Apart from mortality, these adverse events were not
prespecified and were analysed post hoc; the outcome definitions reported
by each trial were used.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| label: tbl-adverse-events

fits_ae |>
  purrr::imap(ae_row) |>
  purrr::list_rbind() |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `Pr(Benefit)`, decimals = 2) |>
  gt::cols_align("center", columns = -`Adverse Event`) |>
  style_gt() |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.border.top.width = gt::px(2),
    table.border.top.color = "black",
    column_labels.border.top.width = gt::px(2),
    column_labels.border.top.color = "black",
    table.border.bottom.width = gt::px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    table_body.border.bottom.width = gt::px(2),
    table_body.border.bottom.color = "black") |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      gt::cell_fill(color = "grey90"),
      gt::cell_borders(sides = "bottom", weight = gt::px(2), color = "black")),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(columns = dplyr::everything())) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Trials reporting the event.",
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(`Number of Trials`)) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Crude event counts, not adjusted for clustering.",
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(c(BMES, Saline))) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(

  gt::tab_footnote(

    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(`Pr(Benefit)`))
```

## Assessment of Bias

Risk of bias was assessed with the Clarity tool adapted for cluster
designs. Small-study and publication bias were assessed with a
contour-enhanced funnel plot and Bayesian Egger regression, with the
posterior slope reported as a median and 95% credible interval. With a
low number of trials both have low power and are sensitive to the
assumed within-trial variances; they are reported descriptively and are
not used to adjust the pooled estimate.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: "Risk of bias assessment (DistillerSR tool, adapted for cluster designs)."
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-align: center

bayesfoRest::rob_plot(data = dat_rob, add_rob_legend = TRUE, rob_tool = "distillersr", show_overall = FALSE)
```

## Assessment of Heterogeneity

Between-trial heterogeneity is characterised by $\tau$ (posterior median
and 95% credible interval), with the prediction interval for a new trial
reported alongside the posterior for $\mu$. Because $\tau$ may be weakly
informed at this number of trials, we additionally assess whether the
heterogeneity estimate is data-informed rather than prior-driven, and
whether it is consistent with its prior (no prior–data conflict).

```{r}
#| label: heterogeneity-assessment

pd <- prior_dominance(fit_hosp_los_re, data = dat_hosp_los, tau_grid = c(0.5, 0.75, 1.5))

tau_draws <- fit_hosp_los_re$draws$tau
tau_med <- stats::median(tau_draws)
tau_ci <- stats::quantile(tau_draws, c(0.025, 0.975), names = FALSE)

tau_contraction <- pd$contraction$contraction[pd$contraction$parameter == "tau"]
tau_pctile <- pd$percentile$prior_percentile[pd$percentile$parameter == "tau"]
tau_flag <- pd$percentile$flag[pd$percentile$parameter == "tau"]
```

Between-trial heterogeneity was $\tau =$ `r round(tau_med, 2)` days (95%
CrI `r round(tau_ci[1], 2)` to `r round(tau_ci[2], 2)`). The
heterogeneity estimate had a posterior contraction of
`r round(tau_contraction, 2)`, and its posterior median lay at the
`r scales::percent(tau_pctile, accuracy = 1)` percentile of its prior
(`r tau_flag`).

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 9
#| out-width: "70%"
#| fig-align: center

overall_plot(fit_hosp_los_re, add_mu = FALSE, add_tau = TRUE, estimand = "MD")

```

For the secondary continuous outcomes, prior dominance was assessed in the
same way, using a grid of $\tau$ priors at 0.5, 1 and 2 times the
weakly regularising scale.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-prior-dominance-secondary

pd_secondary <- list(
  `ICU LOS` = list(fit = fit_icu_los_re, data = dat_icu_los, key = "icu_los"),
  `Time to DKA resolution` = list(fit = fit_dka_res_re, data = dat_time_res, key = "time_res"),
  `Duration of insulin infusion` = list(fit = fit_insulin_dur_re, data = dat_insulin_dur, key = "insulin_dur")) |>
  purrr::map(\(x) {
    prior_dominance(
      x$fit,
      data = x$data,
      tau_grid = 0.5 * ext_sd[[x$key]] * c(0.5, 1, 2))
  })

pd_secondary |>
  purrr::imap(\(pd, nm) {
    tibble::tibble(
      Outcome = nm,
      Parameter = pd$contraction$parameter,
      Contraction = pd$contraction$contraction,
      `Prior percentile` = pd$percentile$prior_percentile[match(pd$contraction$parameter, pd$percentile$parameter)],
      Flag = pd$percentile$flag[match(pd$contraction$parameter, pd$percentile$parameter)])
  }) |>
  purrr::list_rbind() |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Outcome") |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = Contraction, decimals = 2) |>
  gt::fmt_percent(columns = `Prior percentile`, decimals = 0) |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::md("**Prior dominance: secondary continuous outcomes**")) |>
  style_gt()
```

## Sensitivity Analysis

The robustness of the primary estimate was assessed against (i)
alternative estimands — difference in medians, ratio of medians, and
mean difference using alternative median-to-mean conversion methods;
(ii) alternative model specifications; (iii) alternative priors —
weakly regularising ($\mu \sim N(0,1)$, $\tau \sim \text{HN}(0, 0.75)$), vague ($\mu \sim (0,3)$, $\tau \sim \text{HN}(0, 0.75)$) informative ($\mu \sim N(-0.5, 0.30)$,
$\tau \sim \text{HN}(0, 0.75)$); (iv) exclusion of trials at
high risk of bias; and (v) the specification of the
heterogeneity prior.

```{r}
mu_draws <- function(fit) fit$draws$mu

est_row <- function(fit, estimand, method, mcid, ratio = FALSE) {
  mu <- mu_draws(fit)

  q <- c(fit$summary$median[1], fit$summary$q2.5[1], fit$summary$q97.5[1])
  if (ratio) q <- exp(q)

  tibble::tibble(
    Estimand = estimand,
    Method = method,
    k = sum(grepl("^theta\\[", names(fit$draws))),
    `Estimate [95% CrI]` = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", q[1], q[2], q[3]),
    `Pr(Benefit)` = mean(mu < 0),
    `Pr(Benefit > MCID)` = mean(mu < mcid))
}
```

## Heterogeneity ($\tau$) Priors

The pooled effect was examined across a range of half-normal priors for
the between-trial heterogeneity $\tau$, holding the $\mu$ prior fixed.
For each prior we report the pooled mean difference, the heterogeneity
estimate, and whether the data conflict with that prior.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-tau-sensitivity
#| tbl-cap: "Prior-dominance assessment: posterior contraction, prior percentile of the posterior median, and the pooled effect across a grid of tau priors."

gt_prior_dominance(pd)

sweep_tau <- tau_scale_sweep(
  fit_hosp_los_re,
  data = dat_hosp_los,
  scales = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 3))

plot_tau_scale_sweep(sweep_tau, null_value = 0)
```

Across half-normal priors for $\tau$ with scales from 0.5 to 1.5 days,
the pooled mean difference ranged from
`r sprintf("%.3f to %.3f", min(pd$tau_sensitivity$mu_median), max(pd$tau_sensitivity$mu_median))`
days (a shift of `r round(diff(range(pd$tau_sensitivity$mu_median)), 3)`
days).

## GRADE Summary of Findings

```{r, warning=FALSE}
trial_kn <- function(data) {
  data <- if ("event_int_raw" %in% names(data)) dplyr::filter(data, !is.na(event_int_raw)) else data
  n <- if ("n_int_raw" %in% names(data)) data$n_int_raw + data$n_ctrl_raw else data$n_int + data$n_ctrl
  sprintf("%s (%d)", format(sum(n), big.mark = ","), nrow(data))
}

ctrl_mean <- function(data) stats::weighted.mean(data$mean_ctrl, data$n_ctrl)
ctrl_risk <- function(data) 1000 * sum(data$event_ctrl_raw) / sum(data$n_ctrl_raw)

sof_row <- function(draws, data, outcome, type, baseline, mcid = NA_real_, certainty, comment = NA_character_, higher_better = FALSE) {
  q <- function(x) stats::quantile(x, c(0.5, 0.025, 0.975), names = FALSE)
  p0 <- baseline / 1000
  out <- switch(type,
    md = list(
      ctrl = sprintf("%.1f", baseline),
      int = q(baseline + draws),
      eff = draws,
      rel = sprintf("MD %.2f (%.2f to %.2f)", q(draws)[1], q(draws)[2], q(draws)[3]),
      fmt = "%.1f (%.1f to %.1f)"),
    rr = list(
      ctrl = sprintf("%.0f per 1000", baseline),
      int = q(baseline * exp(draws)),
      eff = draws,
      rel = sprintf("RR %.2f (%.2f to %.2f)", exp(q(draws))[1], exp(q(draws))[2], exp(q(draws))[3]),
      fmt = "%.0f per 1000 (%.0f to %.0f)"),
    or = list(
      ctrl = sprintf("%.0f per 1000", baseline),
      int = q(1000 * stats::plogis(stats::qlogis(p0) + draws)),
      eff = stats::plogis(stats::qlogis(p0) + draws) - p0,
      rel = sprintf("OR %.2f (%.2f to %.2f)", exp(q(draws))[1], exp(q(draws))[2], exp(q(draws))[3]),
      fmt = "%.0f per 1000 (%.0f to %.0f)"))
  benefit <- if (higher_better) out$eff else -out$eff
  tibble::tibble(
    Outcome = outcome,
    `Risk with saline` = out$ctrl,
    `Risk with BMES (95% CrI)` = sprintf(out$fmt, out$int[1], out$int[2], out$int[3]),
    `Relative effect (95% CrI)` = out$rel,
    `Pr(Benefit)` = mean(benefit > 0),
    `Pr(Benefit > MCID)` = if (is.na(mcid)) NA_real_ else mean(benefit > mcid),
    `Participants (trials)` = trial_kn(data),
    Certainty = certainty,
    Comments = comment)
}

grade_sym <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_match(x,
    "High" ~ "\u2295\u2295\u2295\u2295 High",
    "Moderate" ~ "\u2295\u2295\u2295\u25EF Moderate",
    "Low" ~ "\u2295\u2295\u25EF\u25EF Low",
    "Very low" ~ "\u2295\u25EF\u25EF\u25EF Very low")
}

tbl_sof <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  sof_row(fit_hosp_los_re$draws$mu, dat_hosp_los, "Hospital LOS (days)", "md", 3.75, mcid = 0.5,
    certainty = "Moderate", comment = "Downgraded for risk of bias and imprecision"),
  sof_row(fit_icu_los_re$draws$mu, dat_icu_los, "ICU LOS (hours)", "md", 41.6, mcid = 6,
    certainty = "Very low", comment = "Downgraded for risk of bias, inconsistency and imprecision"),
  sof_row(fit_dka_res_re$draws$mu, dat_time_res, "Time to DKA resolution (hours)", "md", ctrl_mean(dat_time_res), mcid = 6,
    certainty = "Low"),
  sof_row(fit_res24_ce$draws$mu, dat_res24, "DKA resolution at 24 hours", "or", ctrl_risk(dat_res24), mcid = 0.10,
    certainty = "Low", higher_better = TRUE),
  sof_row(fit_insulin_dur_re$draws$mu, dat_insulin_dur, "Duration of insulin infusion (hours)", "md", 42, mcid = 6,
    certainty = "Low"),
  sof_row(fits_ae$Mortality$draws$mu, dat_ae$Mortality, "Mortality", "rr", 14,
    certainty = "Low")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Certainty = grade_sym(Certainty))

tbl_sof |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::md("**Summary of Findings and Certainty of Evidence: Balanced Multielectrolyte Solution Compared with 0.9% Saline for Patients with DKA**")) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Anticipated absolute effects",
    columns = c(`Risk with saline`, `Risk with BMES (95% CrI)`)) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = dplyr::starts_with("Pr("), decimals = 2) |>
  gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "\u2014") |>
  style_gt() |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
  "Baseline values: hospital and ICU LOS (medians) and mortality from Venkatesh (2015); insulin infusion duration from Chua (2012); time to DKA resolution (participant-weighted mean) and resolution at 24 hours (pooled proportion) from the saline arms of included trials.",
  locations = gt::cells_column_labels(`Risk with saline`)) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Saline baseline plus the pooled effect applied to each posterior draw; the baseline is treated as fixed. For LOS outcomes, the mean difference is applied to a median baseline.",
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(`Risk with BMES (95% CrI)`)) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Posterior probability the effect favours BMES (shorter stay/duration, more patients resolved, lower mortality).",
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(`Pr(Benefit)`)) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "MCID: 0.5 days for hospital LOS; 6 hours for ICU LOS, time to DKA resolution and insulin infusion duration; 10% absolute difference for resolution at 24 hours (at the saline baseline). No MCID for mortality (any difference considered important).",
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(`Pr(Benefit > MCID)`)) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Common-effect model; odds ratio applied to the saline baseline.",
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = Outcome, rows = Outcome == "DKA resolution at 24 hours")) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    "Cluster crossover trials adjusted using effective sample size; participant counts are unadjusted.",
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = Outcome, rows = Outcome %in% c("DKA resolution at 24 hours", "Mortality")))
```


## Model Diagnostics

Convergence was assessed by $\hat{R} < 1.01$, bulk and tail effective
sample sizes above 400 per chain, absence of divergent transitions, and
inspection of trace, rank and autocorrelation plots. Fit was assessed by
posterior predictive checks. Models failing these criteria are reported
as non-convergent rather than interpreted (protocol 2.8.10).
